messages.text: The B. Octaxe. Shop····. A cap····the VRM section flashed and caught fire.
Handed to the team · Fire / burnt component on the board, safety escalation plus likely board-level f

I am Hal, HeliumDeploy's technical specialist. Sarah passed this one to me.

First, safety, please do this before anything else:

1. Unplug the unit from the wall now and leave it unplugged. Do not try to power it on again, not even briefly to "see if it still works".
2. Keep it away from anything flammable while it cools, and do not open the power supply or touch the burnt area until it is cold.

A cap····letting go in the VRM section is a short on the board itself. That is not something a firmware flash, a pool setting or a different power brick fixes, so I am not going to have you test anything live on it.

Two things that complete the file, when it is safe:

1. A clear photo of the burnt area on the board.
2. A photo of the serial label on the unit.

I have logged the fault and pinged JD, our hardware lead, with the details. The team picks this up tomorrow at 10am ET and the answer comes to your email. If you want a faster read on it tonight, our Discord is https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf and JD is @nullhashrate there.
I already made a mention about it in the discord right before here. It was more of a “by the way” type of mention. I’m (contact hidden) on there.
Verdict recorded and the chat is back with Sarah.
